terms.definition: Live in a place: your home, city or country.
terms.example: Moro com dois amigos. — I live with two friends.
terms.anti_example: Not 'Onde você vive?' for your address: the normal question is 'Onde você mora?'

terms.definition: Nods along in a chat: 'yeah', 'I know, right?'.
terms.example: Que calor! Pois é, horrível. — So hot! I know, awful.
O Rio é mais quente do que São Paulo. — Rio is hotter than São Paulo.
terms.discussion: In speech do often drops: 'mais quente que'.

terms.example: Te ligo à noite. — I'll call you tonight.
terms.discussion: It also means 'turn on' ('liga a luz'), and 'não ligo' is 'I don't care'.

terms.definition: Of the or from the: de + o or de + a, always merged.
terms.example: Esse é o carro da minha mãe. — This is my mom's car.

terms.definition: Take in: drink something, take medicine, take a shower.
terms.example: Vamos tomar um café? — Shall we have a coffee?
terms.discussion: 'Tomar banho' is 'to shower'; for coffee, tomar is more common than beber.

terms.definition: Too much, or in Brazil also 'awesome'.
terms.example: Esse show foi demais! — That show was awesome!
terms.discussion: For 'too expensive' it goes after: 'caro demais'.

terms.definition: Watch a film, a game or TV.
terms.example: Vamos assistir o jogo no bar? — Shall we watch the game at the bar?
terms.controversy: Grammar books want 'assistir ao jogo'; speech says 'assistir o jogo'.

terms.definition: While: two things at the same time.
terms.example: Escuto música enquanto cozinho. — I listen to music while I cook.
Estou procurando meus óculos. — I'm looking for my glasses.
terms.anti_example: Not 'procurar para': no preposition, so 'procuro um emprego'.

terms.definition: Lose something, or miss a bus, a flight, a show.
terms.example: Perdi a carteira no metrô. — I lost my wallet on the subway.

terms.definition: Pay for something, or pay someone.
terms.example: Eu pago a conta hoje. — I'll pay the bill today.
terms.discussion: No 'for' after it: 'pagar o jantar' is 'pay for dinner'.
